changes: Separate a retained selection draft from freshly read runtime roots. Ordinary category/visibility changes and read refresh/failure do not overwrite the draft; show actual read roots and provide explicit adoption/discard.

Bind form ownership to API, epoch and order-independent project ID-to-cwd mapping. Semantic ownership changes remount the form monotonically, including ABA, while renames/reordering retain equivalent mapping drafts.
Bind consent to the current read, draft and visibility/enabled state. Revoke it synchronously when editing, refreshing or submitting.

Lock selection and consent while reading, applying or resolving unknown receipts, including the accepted-receipt finalization window. This intentionally prevents new checkbox edits during a pending submission; userEvent regressions verify the lock.

Keep not_sent recovery refresh local, preserving the draft; only accepted writes clear the submitted draft and notify the parent configuration refresh. Unknown outcomes only query the original operation ID, never resend.
Use the existing Api.beginMutation durable-admission prepare guard for this scoped action; an unmounted API/epoch/project mapping owner cannot dispatch the old IDs after persistence completes.

Add 15 meaningful cases to the existing skill-library test file, covering category return, initial/delayed/failed reads, explicit current-state adoption, pending edits, repeated clicks, current state after application, accepted/not_sent unknown recovery, owner ABA and late results, equivalent mapping, changed enabled state, admission cancellation and a newly confirmed intent after not_sent. Observe actual beginMutation promises in fixture cleanup.

Before new freezing, bind mounted-owner invalidation to useLayoutEffect cleanup so commit-time unmount synchronously blocks a durable-admission prepare callback before passive effects run. Other logic unchanged.

Accepted-recovery assertion observed the retained-draft DOM before the React update committed. Added an explicit finalizing lock and waited for the user-visible retained-draft notice to clear.
